easyPrerequisites:
Neerdiv has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Neerdiv, Devious Diver does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Neerdiv using Seeker of Skybreak's ability by tapping it.
Neerdiv triggers, causing a player to mill cards equal to its power.
Resolve the Neerdiv ability from step 1, untapping it.
Repeat.
